- Term length + auto-renew (they've proposed 36 months with annual auto-renew)
- Commitment tiers vs overage governance (no explicit burst policy)
- Data processing and egress cost callouts (unclear in SF section)

B) Auto-renew: propose 90-day notice and a short renewal window; include opt-out for regulatory review.
